lina_cs: FYI — Sora Data is requesting a Kansai (osaka) edge allowlist + short transient rate bump for a partner demo Monday 2026-04-20 15:00 JST. Expect ~1.2k calls in ~20m. Also marking renewal watch: minimal prod traffic last 40d.
ashley_net: Copy. Do they have static egress IPs or should we accept header-based allowlist?
hiro_sora: we can provide a static CIDR 203.0.116.0/28. Header fallback OK if needed: X-RW-CUSTOMER: sora-demo and X-RW-DEMO: yes.
miguel_ops: Need exact window + burst vs sustained qps and p95 latency target. Also confirm region scoping (osaka only).
hiro_sora: Start 2026-04-20T15:00:00+09:00, duration 25m. Burst to 70 req/s, sustained 30 req/s. p95 target <170ms. Osaka-edge only.
lina_cs: CS note — renewal in ~6w, low prod usage. We'll run an enablement after demo and capture feedback.
ashley_net: I'll prepare a temporary allowlist rule scoped to jp-osaka with auto-expire + revoke at 16:00 JST. Miguel — want fallback routing and prefix KV cache?
miguel_ops: yes. Auto-expire ticketed rule, fallback to model-small if p95 > 250ms for 60s, enable prefix KV caching for prefix sora/stage.
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-6450: "Sora Data JP-OSAKA allowlist + demo bump" (expires 2026-04-20T16:00:00+09:00). Assigned miguel_ops.
lina_cs: please add post-demo survey link and schedule 1:1 if demo successful; update renewal status to "engaging".
miguel_ops: rule pushed to osaka-edge (allow 203.0.116.0/28 + header pair). KV cache warmed, fallback route set to model-small at p95>250ms. Ticket CS-6450 updated with links to pre-demo smoke checklist.
hiro_sora: we'll run smoke at 14:30 JST and post results here. thanks for the quick help :thumbsup:
